payload._note: No named customer concentration disclosed. The filing discusses revenue generated through two primary operating segments: (1) Rent-A-Center segment (~47% of consolidated revenues) which serves individual consumers through company-owned stores and e-commerce, and (2) Acima segment (~48% of consolidated revenues) which provides lease-to-own solutions through third-party retail partners. While the filing discloses that in 2023, approximately 39% and 21% of merchandise purchases were attributable to Ashley Furniture Industries and Whirlpool respectively as SUPPLIERS, these are vendors from whom Upbound purchases inventory - not customers who purchase from Upbound. The filing does not disclose any individual customer accounting for 10% or more of revenues, nor does it provide aggregated concentration metrics for top customers. Revenue is recurring in nature given the weekly/bi-weekly/semi-monthly/monthly lease renewal structure of the business model.
